BiblicalUsage: Hashubah is listed among the sons of Zerubbabel, one name in the line of David after the exile. He is named only here, with no deed attached, and his place in the genealogy is the whole of his record.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name in the line of David is never wasted ink. Hashubah belongs to the family through which God kept His promise, and that is enough to matter.
